dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular, interlocking 'O' and 'C' shaped structures are visible along the mid-to-upper dorsal region. These structures exhibit thin, high-intensity light-grey perimeters with sharp gradient transitions from the darker exterior pelt to the light boundary lines. The geometry is characterized by jagged, non-uniform edges forming complex loops.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of localized, solid high-intensity light-grey pixel clusters is observed on the lower lateral flank. These blobs lack internal gradients and appear as isolated punctate marks or small, asymmetrical groupings distinct from the larger annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Three prominent macro-annuli in the upper-central dorsal region form an obtuse triangular spatial arrangement. The relative angles between the centroids of these loops create a wide-based polygon when connected to the high-intensity blob clusters located lower on the flank.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct circular, dark-intensity indentation with a defined perimeter is visible on the upper posterior dorsal surface, appearing as a focal break in the natural pelt pattern.
other_distinctive_markers: The posterior flipper surfaces exhibit unique, high-contrast vertical light-intensity striations and localized spotting not found on the main body trunk.
